newsitem.title: UK: Euro cotton sees second half covering demand.
newsitem.headline: Euro cotton sees second half covering demand.

text.p: The attention of many buyers remains focused on covering outstanding shipment requirements between now and the late autumn, brokers said.
However, the volume of new business was limited in the absence of fresh price stimulus.
Comparatively more active trading conditions meanwhile prevailed in Turkey, where foreign styles appeared relatively attractive on price grounds in comparison with domestic cottons.
Some greater enquiry for U.S. cottons has also been recently noted from Russia which, like Turkey, may seek to take advantage of U.S. credit guarantees.
